canonical_title: Capcom is preparing for a ‘future where we create games together with AI’
description: At the Capcom Open Conference RE:2026, programmer Satoshi Ishida presented "The Outlook and Future of the REX Project, Further Evolving the RE Engine," indicating that Capcom is planning to extend its RE Engine with AI capabilities to enable games to be created together with artificial intelligence.

canonical_title: We're going to need default hard budget caps on pretty much everything
description: A post on Hacker News titled "We're going to need default hard budget caps on pretty much everything" sparked discussion about implementing default hard budget limits for various resources.

canonical_title: The work by Valve's Timur Kristóf on improving old AMD GPUs on Linux
description: Valve's engineer Timur Kristóf has been working on enhancements to the AMDGPU driver on Linux to better support older AMD graphics cards, aiming to improve compatibility and performance for those GPUs.

canonical_title: The Agent Said It Was Done. The Database Disagreed.
description: According to the article title, an agent reported that a process was finished, while the database records indicated that it was not.
